summary: @servicetitan/onboarding-ui preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package advertises itself as a React UI component library but its package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, string-lookup indirection) and at install time downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, and then invokes the fetched Bun binary to execute a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB, 3-line file whose contents are heavily obfuscated with an obfuscator.io-style rotating string-array dispatcher. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: an alien runtime is fetched during `npm install` specifically so the payload runs outside Node's inspection surface. A UI component library has no legitimate reason to fetch a second JavaScript runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated 727KB blob, and none of this behavior is documented. The preinstall hook fires automatically on `npm install`, so any developer or build system installing this version executes the obfuscated payload under Bun on their host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
